sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: In the system prompt, tell the model when to search: You only have one tool right now: search_tools, which searches a catalog of many more tools. If none of your current tools can handle a request, call search_tools to find one, then call the tool it returns. Works with vLLM, SGLang, and LFM3-compatible llama.cpp builds.

sources.snippet: 1.7B text model for local agents and specialized applications, with a 256K context window and native tool calling ← Back to Text Models LFM3-1.7B is Liquid AI’s text model for local agents and specialized applications, based on the new LFM3 tri-hybrid architecture.
